The velvet piping at the yoke and pocket edge adds a luxe touch. The “Les Paul™ Supreme Ebony” inspired black and gold color scheme is set off by the bold Merc house tartan check lining inside. The interior of the jacket also boasts a custom-printed “Gibson technical spec” cotton twill label underneath the internal pocket. Finished with corozo nut buttons, antique gold YKK zipper, and a custom swing tag. 60% Cotton, 40% Polyester Twill. Fits True to Size. Dry Clean Only. Low Iron.
